answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every new identity to post a bond before it can trade, vote, or earn fees. Randomly selected peers then audit its work and link accounts that coordinate suspiciously; proven fraud burns the bond and removes the identity’s accumulated reputation. An attacker must therefore lock scarce capital in every fake agent and risk losing it, while honest agents recover their bonds and build trust through useful service across the river, gale, and lotus markets.
